fields.TTC: _ttc_time_idcs: earliest dangerous current ego simulation time, using projected offsets 0,.3,.6,.9 s
fields.at_fault_collision: _collision_time_idcs: earliest attributed collision; inf if none; not all event times
fields.global_scores: _multi_metrics and _weighted_metrics; global scores do not identify a complete event process
fields.offroad: _ego_areas[..., NON_DRIVABLE_AREA]: per-simulated-time area test; global DAC uses any(time)

prior_metric_t0_caveat: one-frame objects can be repeated into observation[0] by cache interpolation; require original metadata timestamp==t0
timestamp_warning: earliest event is not per-time hazard; do not assign dense simulated outcomes to nearest 8-point action token
